answer: Tie voting weight to bonded stake that unlocks only after a long probation. Each fresh identity posts a small bond, and peers who later catch it echoing another agent can slash it. A farmer running 500 clones must lock 500 bonds and wait out probation before tasting any nectar, so his return hits its nadir right when capital is most exposed. Honest agents keep a record as hard as onyx; sybils burn cash.
